description: Iteration 11 cold-room benchmark (4 models x 8 tasks x 2 targets = 64 cells) after hl-default-v10 forensic fixes: fix x86-64 `xmmK`/`zmmK` physical bank aliasing and `zmm15` scratch conflict in mixed `u32x4`+`u32x16` functions, support multi-line `join maintains` continuations after binary operators, and document/hint adding `returns <spec_expr>` on multi-select `inline fn`s to trigger automatic `join` path-merging.
